verdicts.reason: A is a clean but timid shrink of the original: headline, subhead, logo and the 'SOLSTICE' label on the product are all undersized for the 192px height (the subhead is barely legible), with large empty bands above and below, so it reads as a scaled copy rather than a rearrangement. B actually rearranges the design and gives the headline and CTA proper prominence and readable sizes, but it is cramped: the headline runs almost into the Shop Now button, the centred logo doesn't line up with the left-aligned headline block, and the product sits jammed against the left edge.
